# Two-dimensional PDP: temperature and humidity

```{r bike-pdp-2d-sample}
set.seed(123)
bike_sample_50 <- bike_clean[sample(nrow(bike_clean), 50), ]

kable(
  summary(bike_sample_50[, c("temp", "hum", "cnt")]),
  caption = "Summary of the random sample of 50 observations used for the 2D PDP."
)
```

```{r bike-pdp-2d-computation}
pdp_bike_temp_hum <- partial(
  object = bike_rf,
  pred.var = c("temp", "hum"),
  train = bike_sample_50[, names(bike_sample_50) != "cnt"],
  grid.resolution = 12,
  progress = "none"
)

kable(head(pdp_bike_temp_hum), caption = "First rows of the 2D PDP grid for temperature and humidity.")
```
